tests.name: Registration (API 1.1) AU-R01 valid registration returns 200, the success message and a numeric id
Registration (API 1.1) AU-R02 a registered user can log in with the same credentials (API 1.2)
Login and lock (API 1.2, README FR-02) AU-L01 correct credentials return 200, a JWT and the user
Login and lock (API 1.2, README FR-02) AU-L02 the JWT carries the user id and role (FR-02, SEC-03)
Login and lock (API 1.2, README FR-02) AU-L03 wrong password is refused with 401 (convention) and no token
Login and lock (API 1.2, README FR-02) AU-L04 unknown email gets the same status and body as a wrong password (FR-02: no cause leaked)
Login and lock (API 1.2, README FR-02) AU-L05 three consecutive wrong passwords lock the account: the correct password is then refused (FR-02)
Login and lock (API 1.2, README FR-02) AU-L06 the lock still holds 29 seconds after the third wrong attempt (FR-02: 30 s)
Login and lock (API 1.2, README FR-02) AU-L07 a lock whose time has passed no longer blocks login
Login and lock (API 1.2, README FR-02) AU-L08 a successful login resets the failure counter: wrong, ok, wrong, ok never locks (FR-02 "consecutive")
Login and lock (API 1.2, README FR-02) AU-L09 failures of one account do not lock another account
Forgot / reset password (API 1.3-1.4, README FR-03, SEC-07) AU-P01 forgot-password for a registered email returns 200, the message and a reset token (API 1.3)
Forgot / reset password (API 1.3-1.4, README FR-03, SEC-07) AU-P02 forgot-password for an unknown email gives no token
Forgot / reset password (API 1.3-1.4, README FR-03, SEC-07) AU-P03 reset with the issued token changes the password: new works, old no longer works (API 1.4)
Forgot / reset password (API 1.3-1.4, README FR-03, SEC-07) AU-P04 reset with a wrong token is refused with 400 (convention) and the password is unchanged
Forgot / reset password (API 1.3-1.4, README FR-03, SEC-07) AU-P05 a token issued to one email cannot reset another account (FR-03)
Forgot / reset password (API 1.3-1.4, README FR-03, SEC-07) AU-P06 a token is invalidated after use (SEC-07): the second reset with it is refused

Profile (API 2.1-2.2, README FR-04, SEC-02) AU-U02 GET /me with an invalid token is refused (SEC-02)
Profile (API 2.1-2.2, README FR-04, SEC-02) AU-U03 GET /me returns the profile of the token owner only (API 2.1)
Profile (API 2.1-2.2, README FR-04, SEC-02) AU-U04 PUT /me updates name, shipping address and phone, and GET /me reflects them (API 2.2)
Profile (API 2.1-2.2, README FR-04, SEC-02) AU-U05 updating one user's profile leaves other users unchanged (FR-04: own profile only)

Profile (API 2.1-2.2, README FR-04, SEC-02) AU-U07 PUT /me without a token is refused with 401 (SEC-02)
